proposed_branch: A-site-disordered P21/c parent realization with 50:50 Sr/Ca occupancy on the A orbit and retained rock-salt Sc/Ta order
reason: The submitted CIF is parseable and symmetry-expands as a primitive 259.16685 A^3, 20-atom Z=2 realization of SrCaScTaO6 with full occupancies; its actual symmetry is Pc (No. 7), not the declared P1. It has charge-balanced Sr2+/Ca2+/Sc3+/Ta5+, no overlaps, complete six-coordinate Sc/Ta octahedra (Sc-O 2.099-2.145 A; Ta-O 2.037-2.093 A), and strong orthorhombic indexing coverage. The trace instantiated and refined a whole-profile model, and its enumeration rejects the other two 2:2 Sr/Ca ordering classes through absent low-angle superlattice lines. However, the selected Pc ordering retains an exactly P21/c-symmetric parent framework and was not compared with Sr/Ca occupational averaging. An independent like-for-like whole-profile comparison gives unweighted RMSE 0.199 for 50:50 Sr/Ca on the parent A orbit versus 0.221 for the submitted ordered model, while a free-intensity profile bound is 0.179 and peak-free background noise is about 0.102. This concrete A-site-disordered P21/c realization preserves composition, indexed reflections, ordered rock-salt Sc/Ta topology, and chemistry, yet is absent from the submitted set and fits better. Thus the exact Sr/Ca occupancy/order choice is not established and another attempt is likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
